## Detailed Features Breakdown

### 1. Server Network — 11,500+ Servers Across 100 Countries

CyberGhost operates one of the largest VPN server networks on the market with over 11,500 servers spread across 120+ locations in 100 countries. Every server runs on 10-Gbps network infrastructure, meaning the backbone can handle massive throughput even during peak hours. 

What truly sets CyberGhost apart is the **specialized server system**. Instead of using generic servers for everything, CyberGhost maintains three categories of purpose-built servers:

- **Streaming-optimized servers**: Individually configured to unblock specific platforms. You'll find servers labeled for Netflix US, Netflix UK, BBC iPlayer, Disney+, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, HBO Max, ESPN+, and more — 35+ services in total. When you select a streaming server, CyberGhost routes your traffic through an IP that's been tested and verified to work with that specific platform.
- **P2P-optimized servers**: Located exclusively in countries with torrent-friendly laws (Switzerland, Romania, Netherlands, Spain, etc.). These servers are configured for high throughput and include SOCKS5 proxy support for additional flexibility.
- **Gaming-optimized servers**: Positioned in data centers near major gaming server hubs to minimize latency. They include DDoS protection to prevent angry opponents from knocking you offline.

All servers are **RAM-only (diskless)** — they run entirely on volatile memory with no hard drives. On every reboot, all data is wiped. This means even if a server were physically seized by authorities, there would be nothing forensically recoverable. This architecture aligns with the strict no-logs policy to create a system where user data simply cannot persist.

The server network has a strong European presence (6,500+ servers) and growing coverage in Africa, the Middle East, and South America. Asia-Pacific coverage is solid but not as dense as ExpressVPN's network.

### 2. Privacy & Security — Romania Jurisdiction and Verified No-Logs

CyberGhost's privacy foundation rests on three pillars:

**Romanian Jurisdiction**: CyberGhost S.R.L. is incorporated in Bucharest, Romania. This matters because Romania is not a member of the 5/9/14 Eyes intelligence-sharing alliance, has no mandatory data retention laws, and its Constitutional Court has ruled that blanket data retention is unconstitutional. In 2024, Romania's data protection authority confirmed that VPN providers are not subject to mandatory logging requirements under Romanian law.

**Strict No-Logs Policy**: CyberGhost's policy states they do not collect or store: browsing history, traffic destination or content, DNS queries, connection timestamps, session duration, bandwidth usage, IP addresses (neither original nor VPN-assigned), or any other activity data. The only data retained is anonymized, aggregated connection counts and server load metrics — data that cannot be traced to any individual user.

**Transparency Reports**: Published quarterly since 2011, CyberGhost's transparency reports document every legal request received. In 2025, they received 203,219 DMCA complaints and 5 police requests — every single one was answered with "no data to share" because the no-logs policy means there is nothing to hand over. This 14-year history of consistent transparency reporting is one of the longest track records in the VPN industry.

The transparency has limits, however. Unlike NordVPN (which has completed 4 independent audits by Deloitte and PwC) or ExpressVPN (27+ audits by Cure53, KPMG, and PwC), CyberGhost has not published a third-party no-logs audit. The transparency reports demonstrate that the company hasn't handed over user data, but an independent technical audit of server configurations would provide stronger verification.

**Encryption & Protocols**: CyberGhost uses AES-256-GCM encryption with 4096-bit RSA keys for the handshake. Three VPN protocols are available:
- **WireGuard** — The default and recommended protocol. Modern, lightweight (~4,000 lines of code), extremely fast. Best for speed-intensive activities.
- **OpenVPN** (UDP/TCP) — The industry standard, battle-tested, and most configurable. Good for networks that block common VPN ports.
- **IKEv2/IPSec** — Excellent for mobile devices due to its ability to handle network switches (Wi-Fi to cellular) without dropping the VPN connection.

**Additional Security Features**:
- **Automatic Kill Switch**: Blocks all internet traffic if the VPN connection drops, preventing accidental IP leaks. Available system-wide or per-app.
- **DNS & IP Leak Protection**: CyberGhost operates its own private DNS servers. All DNS queries are routed through the encrypted tunnel. IPv6 leak protection is also built in.
- **Content Blocker**: Blocks connections to domains associated with ads, trackers, and malware at the DNS level. Works across all apps, not just browsers.
- **Wi-Fi Protection**: Automatically establishes a VPN connection when joining an unsecured or unknown Wi-Fi network. Ideal for coffee shops, airports, and hotels.
- **Split Tunneling**: Route specific apps outside the VPN tunnel while keeping everything else protected. Useful for banking apps that flag VPN IPs or local network devices like printers.
